name: Nucifera 20B
runtime: mlx-lm 0.32 (mlx_lm.server on 127.0.0.1), started by Lotus: lotus ai local
memory_saver: off – gpt-oss keeps part of its memory in a rotating cache that MLX cannot compress

sampling.temperature: the user's creativity setting (lotus ai local settings) – the benchmark ran at 0.2; 1.0 (OpenAI's recommendation) scored about the same, with fewer loops but more slips

reasoning_effort.ultra: high (+ the ultra instructions, up to 6 rounds of going on)

thinking_in_circles: stopped when the last 240 characters of its thinking appeared 3 times (checked from 6000 characters on, every 3000)
tool_calls: harmony format, parsed by Lotus (ChannelSplit) – one call per message, the thinking kept with it
